fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) stock declined 8% on TrendForce's weak 2027 NAND price outlook, posting a monthly decline of 54.9% following the 8-for-1 reverse split on November 20.
fields.summary_ko.1: TrendForce expects Q1 2027 NAND flash contract prices to decline 0–5%, with all product categories declining from Q2 onwards, and 2027 NAND bit supply to increase 25–30%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Micron (MU) declined 5% but had a smaller decline than SanDisk due to its higher HBM business proportion, while SK hynix (SKHY) fell 4% and maintained relatively stable support.
